q: How does a plastic moulding unit in Daman work out CO2 per kg of product?
title: Daman moulding unit CO2 per kg
short: Electricity is the main source. Divide yearly kWh by kilograms moulded and multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. For buyers asking for a product footprint, add the plastic resin itself from the resin supplier or a recognised factor, which is usually larger than the moulding energy.
audience: Plastic processing units in Daman and Silvassa

ul: Grid electricity for moulding machines, chillers and compressors.
Resin weight per part times the resin factor.

p: Servo drives on machines and fixing chiller and compressed air waste cut kWh per kg.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
